findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure random number generation
 * @description Using weak random number generators for security purposes can lead to predictable values
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-random
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-338
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Using random module for security purposes
  call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "choice", "shuffle"]).getACall()
  or
  // Using time-based seeds for random
  exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode seedCall |
    seedCall = API::moduleImport("random").getMember("seed").getACall() and
    exists(int i |
      seedCall.getArg(i).asExpr().toString().regexpMatch(".*time.*")
    )
  )
select call, "Potentially insecure random number generation that may not be cryptographically secure."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure random number generation using weak random functions

message.text: Potentially insecure random number generation that may not be cryptographically secure.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure random usage in retry logic
 * @description Checking specific random usage in retry.py for security implications
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-random-retry
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-338
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Look for random usage in retry.py specifically
  call.getLocation().getFile().getBaseName() = "retry.py" and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "choice", "shuffle"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Insecure random number generation in retry logic that may not be cryptographically secure."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure random number generation in retry logic that may not be cryptographically secure

message.text: Insecure random number generation in retry logic that may not be cryptographically secure.
